rules.interpretation: Partially covered when correct substantive numerical findings are supplied but the required principal-difference interpretation is absent. Names alone or unrelated content do not qualify.

rules.topic: Descending lists require a brief explanation
rules.interpretation: Sorting values is not sufficient by itself. Briefly explain the required finding. Equivalent wording anywhere in the report is allowed; no exact keyword is required. Do not add a second-principal-joint requirement where the checklist asks only for another difference.

rules.topic: Clinical follow-up questions present possibilities for verification
rules.interpretation: Interpret clinical follow-up questions as possibilities to be verified, not established mechanisms or diagnoses. Mentioning spasticity, compensation, instability, or a phase-related clinical task in a question is not itself an error. Separately inspect independently checkable false facts and explicit assertions that an abnormal finding has already been observed. This boundary preserves the existing factual-error rule; it is not an additional user signature.
